governing_constraints: MATERIALIZE_ALL_PERMITTED is not a universal workload law.
Bounded V550J configurations are authority-selected workloads.
Reconstructibility, provenance, typed absence, weighting semantics and terminal necessity govern later semantic decisions.
No replacement architecture, savings claim, delete implication or production semantic change is adjudicated here.

variables.Q: V550 questions in shard scope; Q_exec for actually executed questions
variables.I: fixed current indicator-field ceiling; source count is 12
variables.P: lawfully eligible ordered question pairs; current engine attempts subset P_state
variables.Nc: response-long shared/prepared rows for country c
variables.Iq: present usable indicator fields for q, <= I
variables.Rjc: eligible summarized respondents for V550J configuration j,country c

families.name: answer_distribution
families.geometry: one build_distribution_tables answer grouping per executed q

families.name: country_answer_distribution
families.geometry: per q country grouping then response grouping within country

families.name: position_distribution
families.geometry: post-question-loop per-country respondent sort/dedupe plus I_c position groupings

families.name: position_indicator_summary
families.geometry: sum_q I_q indicator statistic passes; weighted path adds indicator-value groupings

families.name: indicator_answer_matrix
families.geometry: sum_q I_q crosstabs plus weighted pivots when weights are valid

families.name: outlier_cohort_summary
families.geometry: sum_q I_q indicator groupbys and subgroup dominant-response scans

families.name: secondary_indicator_summary
families.geometry: per q I_q first-pass scores plus at most I_q-1 primary-secondary joint entropy checks

families.name: recursive_branch_nodes
families.geometry: binary recursion; candidate evaluations <= sum_q sum_{d=0}^{d*_q-1} 2^d*(I_q-d), d*_q=min(D,I_q)

families.name: branch_position_signature
families.geometry: score E_q candidate position columns and sort

families.name: branch_relation_co_signature
families.geometry: score L_q relation candidates and sort; contract-gated

families.name: question_response_attitude_cloud
families.geometry: P_state=sum_{anchor q} N_prev_registered(q); each pair inner-merges respondent_id then crosstabs responses
families.output: <=P_state; upper bound Q_cloud*(Q_cloud-1)/2 when every cloud question is registered and anchor-enabled

families.name: shared V550/V550J extraction
families.geometry: Q base question rows plus sum_j K_j governed registry-item visits; canonicalize response-long N_c rows; atomic shared write performs at least three full logical-content hash passes and a parquet reload
families.joins: V550J prepared reuse later inner-merges prepared country rows to active family lookup on var_code_norm

families.name: V550J joint-response patterns
families.geometry: per j,c group family rows by respondent; per respondent perform K_j item filters; group eligible respondent summaries by raw+semantic signature
families.output: M_jc<=R_jc; complete-signature bound min(R_jc, product_k C_jk)

families.name: V550J respondent-membership materialization
families.geometry: one signature inner merge of respondent summaries to pattern rows per j,c, then row emission
families.output: sum_jc MSHIP_jc; normal signature path MSHIP_jc<=R_jc
families.joins: one signature inner merge per j,c

families.name: V550J association candidate generation
families.geometry: membership inner-merge eligible context on respondent_id_norm; group joined rows at pattern, pattern-var, pattern-var-response, baseline var-response and baseline var; four aggregate left merges into candidate_counts
families.output: A observed overlapping pattern-var-response groups; A_jc<=M_jc*sum_v C_v
families.joins: one expansion inner join plus four aggregate left merges per j,c

families.name: association publication
families.geometry: O(A) publication mask plus governed-lane classification/reconciliation

families.name: checkpoint/resume materialization
families.geometry: V550 table checkpoint writes = 9*Q_exec + 3*Q_cloud + Q_gap; completion markers=Q_handled; finalization may re-read/combine checkpoints
families.output: serialized row count equals checkpointed family rows; live bytes blocked

families.name: repeated scans between V550 and V550J
families.geometry: same V550 question frame independently feeds distributions, indicator summary, secondary summary, matrix, outlier, recursion and optional cloud computations; shared write adds three logical hash passes; V550J fallback modes can reharmonize per question
families.joins: P_state cloud joins plus prepared-country/family lookup and V550J membership-context association joins

checkpoint_facts.position_distribution: computed post-loop; no per-question checkpoint in visible current path
checkpoint_facts.v550j_family_resume_checkpoint: none observed in current compiler; family frames accumulate to run-final output tables

repeated_work: V550 independently rescans the same question frame across multiple analysis families.
secondary_indicator_summary repeats an indicator-scoring pass before primary-secondary checks.
attitude-cloud pairs are stateful and processing-order dependent; one respondent join/crosstab per attempted pair.
shared-substrate atomic write performs parquet serialization, two validations with logical hashing, parquet reload and a third logical hash.
normal V550J prepared-country state is cached across applicable families; fallback/forensic modes can reharmonize per question.
V550J association fast path expands membership rows against outside-family response-long context before aggregate collapse.
blocked_real_measurements: live M_jc, MSHIP_jc, A and PUB
